source: Generated by the SmartLedger wallet shell (wallet.smartledger.technology) on 2026-10-15 with its own vendored bsv.bundle.js at v9.16.1, and contributed as a pinned external fixture. Its value is that it was produced OUTSIDE this repository, by a consumer, with a version this repository no longer builds — so it fails if Message's wire behaviour moves, including the magic prefix, the varint length, the digest, or the recoverable-signature encoding. It is NOT an independent implementation: it was generated with this library, so it pins behaviour rather than confirming correctness. The generating session states these bytes are stable and that a protocol change would get a v2 vector rather than an edit.
why_this_message: 367 bytes of UTF-8, past any short-string path, containing four LF characters inside the signed text — where a magic-prefix or varint-length change shows up first.
negative_control_note: Keep doesNotVerifyAt. A verifier that returns true unconditionally passes the positive case and fails this one, which is the only reason the positive case means anything.
